purpose: Align Youth module outputs without assuming mathematical equivalence.
input_type: Kaile and Zihan native Youth outputs
preprocessing: No transformation between model scales; compare direction/ranking/effects only.
aggregation_rule: No numeric merging, rescaling, or ensemble.
gene_namespace: mouse gene symbols per module source
limitations: Not a biological scorer or model.

purpose: Transcriptomic similarity to young TMS FACS Limb MSC state.
preprocessing: per-cell library-size normalization to 10000 then log1p
native_output: calibrated youth_score; higher is more young-like
aggregation_rule: Native deployed donor aggregation is arithmetic mean of cell youth_score; GSE condition scoring averages cells within replicate then averages replicate scores within condition.
limitations: Research-only similarity score; not clinical age, safety, causal rejuvenation, or harm evidence.

purpose: Frozen donor-level FACS Limb MSC young-old cohort-state separator.
input_type: gene x sample raw pseudobulk counts; h5ad wrapper accepts cells x genes raw counts
preprocessing: aggregate raw counts within donor/sample; CPM; log2(CPM+1); frozen training mean/sd z-score
native_output: calibrated_score; higher is more young-like relative to training medians
aggregation_rule: Native path scores donor/sample pseudobulk directly; do not average Kaile cell scores into this estimator.
limitations: Not a validated continuous aging clock; external validity and technical independence not established.

purpose: Explain lower GSE176206 SOKM Youth Score using identity, ECM, state fractions, pseudotime, and contextual risk modules.
input_type: raw cell-by-gene counts plus frozen Youth and contextual module scores
preprocessing: module scores use total-count normalize 10000 and log1p; Youth Score keeps own frozen scorer
aggregation_rule: Known animals summarized within mouse-condition and compared as paired SOKM minus control; unknown cells descriptive only.
final_inference_unit: known animal pairs; n=3 per age group
limitations: Not accelerated aging, clinical harm, tumourigenicity, therapeutic efficacy, or validated safety.

purpose: Contextual MSC identity module inside GSE state-remodeling package.
preprocessing: total-count normalize 10000; log1p; primary background-corrected score and rank sensitivity
aggregation_rule: Summarized within known animal-condition for paired contrasts.
limitations: May overlap biologically with dedifferentiation risk but is not mathematically equivalent.

purpose: Diagnose whether zero-shot Geneformer old-young axis is valid on the cleaned FACS MSC cohort.
input_type: raw counts tokenized after mouse-to-human one-to-one ortholog mapping
preprocessing: Geneformer zero-shot embeddings; no fine-tuning; cosine shift toward young centroid
native_output: old-young centroid-axis separation and perturbation shift diagnostic
aggregation_rule: Donor-level LOO and permutation; perturbation ranking superseded if axis fails.
gene_namespace: human Ensembl IDs after ortholog mapping
limitations: Not a general Geneformer failure; output is not a predicted expression matrix and cannot feed Youth/Risk scorers.

purpose: Compare separately run frozen Kaile v1.1 and Zihan v2.1 Youth Scores in GSE176206 as biological follow-up.
input_type: raw cell counts scored through each model's native path
preprocessing: Kaile: per-cell normalize_total 10000 plus log1p then cell score; Zihan: raw-count donor pseudobulk then log2(CPM+1) frozen z-score
aggregation_rule: Kaile uses cell summary; Zihan uses native pseudobulk donor score; no raw-scale comparison or merge.
final_inference_unit: known animal pairs; n=3 per age group
limitations: Model sensitivity and descriptive biology only, not new validation. Available h5ad does not support factor-specific OSKM subset inference.
